text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, Trai-chan. Take a look at this.

The account name is "Rumor Scope." The 
profile says, "Investigating the rumors 
you're curious about."
choice_data_list: ウマッターのアカウント？
choice_data_list_en: An Umatter account?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
That's the thing I made. It's a hobby 
account that doubles for gathering info, 
y'know.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
And guess what? I just got some juicy 
info.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently, there's a secret training 
facility where they gather Umamusume with 
psychic powers."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Plus, there's intel saying that facility 
might be hidden in the mountains nearby.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
They say where there's smoke, there's 
fire, right? Hey, why don't we look into 
it a bit?
choice_data_list_en: Hmm, I wonder if that's true...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trai-chan, watch your step. The path gets 
pretty narrow around here.
choice_data_list: If you slip there, you'd be done for...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
There's no other way forward, after all. 
Summon your courage and let's go♪
choice_data_list: 滑ったら、ひとたまりもなさそうだけど……
choice_data_list_en: One slip and you're done for, though...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what a piece of junk. In movies, the 
cable always snaps halfway through on 
these.
choice_data_list: Huh? Are we crossing this bridge?

text_block_list.text: (Creak, creak, creak...!)
choice_data_list_en: Huh? Are we crossing this bridge?
Huh? Are we crossing this bridge?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it's shaking, it's shaking...!

Transcend pushes forward boldly, even 
through treacherous spots. Following after 
her...
choice_data_list_en: (H-How can she be so unfazed...?)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...! Trainy, look, over there!

According to the map, this should be an 
empty lot. Yet, right in front of me... a 
building exists.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Nice...! It's really starting to feel real 
now.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
As far as I can tell, there doesn't seem 
to be anyone around... Let's get a closer 
look for now.
(Bzzzzz!)
choice_data_list: ? I wonder what that sound is...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ――! Trai-chan, look at that...!
choice_data_list_en: ? What could this sound be...?

text_block_list.text:
Looking over, a swarm of bees was hovering 
a short distance away...! They were 
glaring right at us!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Is she... being wary of me?
choice_data_list:
Let's back away slowly so we don't provoke 
it...!

text_block_list.text:
I somehow managed to reach a spot where 
the buzzing couldn't be heard. I wasn't 
sure what kind of bees they were, but they 
seemed aggressive and might be venomous.
choice_data_list: 刺激しないよう、ゆっくり下がろう……！
choice_data_list_en: Let's back away slowly so we don't provoke it...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hmm...
choice_data_list: とにかく、あれじゃ近づけないな……
とにかく、あれじゃ近づけないね……
choice_data_list_en: Anyway, we can't get close like that...
Anyway, we can't get close like that, can we...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You brought wireless speakers, right? 
If we use those...!
choice_data_list: What are you intending to do?
What are you intending to do?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I found this earlier~. "Music that somehow 
repels bugs." If we just play that through 
the speaker, you know?
choice_data_list_en: What are you planning to do?
What are you up to?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Right?! It's worth a shot. Besides, I'll 
take a route that minimizes contact as 
much as possible.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's not like this plan has zero 
chance of working, right?
choice_data_list: いやいや、それでも危ないって……！
choice_data_list_en: No, no, that's still too dangerous...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Once you know the truth, there might be a 
real thrill waiting for you, right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Then I think I wanna keep moving forward~
choice_data_list:
Even so, I can't let you go anywhere 
dangerous.
...I'm worried, so I'll go with you.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Trainer-chan, you meanie. Boo, boo~.
choice_data_list: それでも危ないところには行かせられない
choice_data_list_en: Even so, I can't let you go somewhere dangerous.
...I'm worried about you, so I'm coming along.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Mmmph...
choice_data_list: それでも君が心配なんだよ、トラン
それでも貴方が心配なの、トラン
choice_data_list_en: Even so, I'm still worried about you, Tran.
Even so, I'm still worried about you, Tran.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Well, if you're putting it that way, 
can't help it.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
In that case... Can we stop by the Hachimi 
stand on the way back?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Let's soothe our hiking fatigue with 
something sweet. Rich. Solid. With 
chocolate toppings.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yay~♪ Let's make that our strategy meeting 
for dealing with bees, then!
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, sure.
Yeah, sure.

text_block_list.text:
Transcend had learned absolutely nothing 
from the experience...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Trainy. That's what I'm 
talking about♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright, the bees aren't coming over. 
Go, go while we still can."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Aaah. To think it was just an ordinary 
ruin. No wonder it wasn't on the map~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, we still have plenty of tips coming 
in. Let's see what the next scoop brings—
(Bzzz... Static...)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Looks like radio interference. Must've 
picked it up from somewhere.
choice_data_list_en: Whoa, the speaker!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Wait a minute? In the middle of the 
mountains with no utility poles? Where on 
earth is this coming from...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Could those ruins be a bluff? Maybe the 
real entrance is somewhere else entirely?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
This is why I can never quit investigating 
tips!
